page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T25 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for accelerated graphics or hardware-dependent machine learning workloads. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a stable resource for predictable workloads. It is designed for general-purpose applications such as mid-range web servers, application backends, containerized microservices, and development environments that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of specialized hardware.
